# std.parse

<!-- Generated by `lang doc std` from the checked interfaces (lang 0.1.0). Do not edit by hand. -->

Grammar parsers with source spans and structured failures.

A grammar is a string — rules `name = alt | alt` (one per line or
`;`-separated) over rule names, `"literals"`, and `/regexes/`, with
`%skip /regex/` skipping text before each terminal — or a list of
programmatic productions. The first rule is the start rule. Left
recursion and ambiguity are supported: `parse` returns one tree and
reports whether others exist; `forest` returns the shared packed parse
forest; `trees` enumerates trees up to a bound and reports cycles;
`parse_recovering` skips unparsable regions and reports each as an error.

## Types

### `Failure`

```lang
pub type Failure = { offset: Int, line: Int, column: Int, expected: List<String> }
```

### `Grammar`

```lang
struct Grammar { id: Int }
```

#### `Grammar.forest`

```lang
fn forest(self: &Self, input: String) -> Result<Data, Failure>
```

The shared packed parse forest:
`{root, ambiguous, cyclic, nodes: [{id, rule, start, end,
alternatives: [[{node} | {token, start, end}]]}]}`.

#### `Grammar.parse`

```lang
fn parse(self: &Self, input: String) -> Result<Parsed, Failure>
```

#### `Grammar.parse_recovering`

```lang
fn parse_recovering(self: &Self, input: String, max_errors: Int) -> Result<Recovered, Failure>
```

Parse, skipping up to `max_errors` unparsable regions.

#### `Grammar.trees`

```lang
fn trees(self: &Self, input: String, limit: Int) -> Result<Trees, Failure>
```

At most `limit` trees, lazily expanded from the forest.

### `Parsed`

```lang
pub type Parsed = { tree: Data, ambiguous: Bool }
```

A parse tree: nodes `{rule, start, end, children}` and tokens
`{token, start, end}` with byte offsets.

### `Production`

```lang
pub type Production = { name: String, alts: List<List<Sym>> }
```

A programmatic production: a rule name and its alternatives.

### `Recovered`

```lang
pub type Recovered = { tree: Data, errors: List<Failure> }
```

A tree built after skipping unparsable regions, one error per region.

### `Sym`

```lang
enum Sym { rule(name: String), lit(text: String), re(pattern: String) }
```

A symbol of a programmatic production.

### `Trees`

```lang
pub type Trees = { trees: List<Data>, truncated: Bool, cyclic: Bool }
```

Enumerated trees: at most the requested number (`truncated` when more
exist), and whether the grammar derives a node from itself here (a
cycle, i.e. infinitely many trees; each is followed once per path).

### `from_productions`


an optional skip pattern.
